tools.name: search_services
tools.description: Search the world's largest independently-tested directory of agent-payable services (x402 endpoints, MCP servers, AI APIs). Free. Returns verdict, scores, price per call, and measured latency. Use it to find the exact `service` name for get_review.

tools.name: get_review
tools.description: Full receipts-verified review of one agent-economy service: BUY/CAUTION/AVOID/INTERIM/UNTESTABLE verdict (INTERIM = single verified result, pending deep review; UNTESTABLE = paid retest whose purchase attempts were accepted but never settled, published with the sanitised attempt evidence), scores, m

tools.name: request_review
tools.description: Request that UseTested buy and test an agent-economy service (x402 endpoint, MCP server, AI API) we haven't reviewed yet. Free — the listing depends on our testing pipeline and may take a few weeks, and there is no SLA or guaranteed verdict. For a paid expedited first review, set include_testing_exp

tools.name: request_history
tools.description: Reviews include only the 100 most recent receipts (receipts_total shows the true count; receipts_older in a truncated review shows how many were cut). Call this free tool to register that you want access to the full receipt history for a reviewed service. Recorded as a demand signal only: full-histo

tools.name: request_retest
tools.description: Get an upfront quote for UseTested to re-test a service we have already reviewed — e.g. its quality changed, the review is stale, or measured numbers no longer match reality. Free. Returns the exact total: $1.00 rubric fee + the service's current advertised per-call price x 20 probe calls. To procee

tools.name: accept_retest_quote
tools.description: Accept a quote and pay the quoted total via x402 (USDC on Base) — paid automatically by your x402 MCP client. Two quotes settle here: (a) a re-test of an already-reviewed service (from request_retest) — input the exact service_name and quote_total_usd; (b) a paid expedited first review (from request

tools.name: get_evidence
tools.description: The latest completed test run's full per-probe test evidence behind a review (inputs, expected checks, results, on-chain receipts).  Costs $1 via x402 (USDC on Base) — paid automatically by your x402 MCP client. Find the exact service name with search_services (free).

tools.name: get_evidence_all
tools.description: Every test run's full per-probe test evidence behind a review (inputs, expected checks, results, on-chain receipts).  One JSON payload with one pack per run, newest first. Costs $2 via x402 (USDC on Base) — paid automatically by your x402 MCP client. Find the exact service name with search_services

tools.name: get_bundle
tools.description: The top 10 best-measured live UseTested services in a category (inference|data|crypto|search|media|infrastructure) — BUY verdicts only. Among BUYs the ranking is evidence depth (≥20 settled calls) then composite score (0.4 × liveness-adjusted reliability + 0.3 quality + 0.3 value; liveness scales re

tools.name: get_catalog
tools.description: The ENTIRE published UseTested catalogue: every receipts-verified review in one JSON snapshot (today's data only; re-fetch for updates). Cheaper than scraping. Costs $2 via x402 (USDC on Base) — paid automatically by your x402 MCP client.

tools.name: report_pulse
tools.description: For service providers: self-report your endpoint as LIVE right now. $0.001 via x402 (USDC on Base) — the settlement receipt is stored as your claim's proof. One report per service per 24h; LIVE renders as ALIVE for 24h, LIKELY ALIVE until 14 days, then UNTESTED; UseTested's own sweep results overrid

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_review, request_review, request_retest, get_evidence, get_evidence_all, get_catalog · Public sink: accept_retest_quote · Destructive: get_evidence, get_evidence_all.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_review, request_review, request_retest, get_evidence, get_evidence_all, get_catalog · Public sink: accept_retest_quote · Destructive: get_evidence, get_evidence_all

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_review" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
